def test_direct_event_charge_api_preserves_native_releases_without_public_callback_claim(self):
        # HORN is reference-only after public prepare. This direct conditional
        # API test checks native outgoing releases/next slots, not activation
        # of the retired public callback effect or inferred in-game kills.
        skill = catalog()['operators'][OP]['skills'][2]['levels'][9]
        for mode in MODES:
            for initial in (False, True):
                for wait_next_attack in (False, True):
                    with self.subTest(mode=mode, initial=initial, wait_next_attack=wait_next_attack):
                        phases = {'initial': [], 'cycle': []}
                        plain = prepared(mode=mode, relic_ids=[HORN, ATTACK_SP],
                                         timing={'sp_events': phases})
                        empty = prepared(mode=mode, relic_ids=[HORN, ATTACK_SP], timing={
                            'sp_events': phases, 'target_windows': [], 'initial_target_windows': []})
                        params = dict(initial=initial, wait_next_attack=wait_next_attack,
                                      attribute_speed=100)
                        baseline = event_charge(plain, skill, 13, 0, .73, 100, **params)
                        observed = event_charge(empty, skill, 13, 0, .73, 100, **params)
                        self.assertIsNotNone(baseline['seconds'])
                        self.assertEqual(observed, baseline)
                        self.assertEqual(observed['credited_callback_events'], 0)

def test_public_reference_only_callback_relic_cannot_restore_retired_event_credit(self):
        for mode in MODES:
            for skill in (1, 3):
                for own_supply in ({}, {'target_windows': [], 'initial_target_windows': []}):
                    with self.subTest(mode=mode, skill=skill, own_supply=own_supply):
                        phases = {'initial': [{'at_seconds': 1, 'type': 'kill'}],
                                  'cycle': [{'at_seconds': 26, 'type': 'kill'}]}
                        baseline = evaluate(skill, mode, relic_ids=[ATTACK_SP],
                                            window_seconds=10, timing=own_supply)
                        reference = evaluate(skill, mode, relic_ids=[HORN, ATTACK_SP],
                                             window_seconds=10, timing={**own_supply, 'sp_events': phases})
                        self.assertSameSP(reference, baseline)
                        self.assertEqual(reference['components'], baseline['components'])
                        self.assertEqual(reference['total_damage'], baseline['total_damage'])
                        self.assertNotIn('sp_events', reference['estimate'])
                        self.assertNotIn('sp_events', baseline['estimate'])
                        record = next(row for row in reference['relic_resolution']['records']
                                      if row['id'] == HORN)
                        self.assertEqual(record['status'], 'reference_only')
                        self.assertEqual(record['applied'], [])
                        self.assertTrue(any(rule['kind'] == 'event_sp'
                                            for rule in record['reference_effects']))
                        self.assertTrue(reference['relic_resolution']['combat_effects_reference_only'])
                        self.assertTrue(any(section['id'] == 'relic_combat_reference'
                                            for section in reference['report']['sections']))

def test_reference_only_callback_relic_keeps_existing_offline_attack_charge(self):
        for mode in MODES:
            with self.subTest(mode=mode):
                timing = {'target_windows': []}
                baseline = evaluate(mode=mode, window_seconds=10, timing=timing)
                result = evaluate(mode=mode, relic_ids=[HORN], window_seconds=10, timing=timing)
                self.assertSameSP(result, baseline)
                self.assertGreater(baseline['estimate']['skill']['initial_seconds'], 0)
                self.assertEqual(result['estimate']['skill'], baseline['estimate']['skill'])
                self.assertNotIn('sp_events', result['estimate'])
                record = next(row for row in result['relic_resolution']['records'] if row['id'] == HORN)
                self.assertEqual(record['status'], 'reference_only')
                self.assertEqual(record['applied'], [])
                self.assertEqual(result['total_damage'], 0)
